akitaDAO.descr: the app ID of the Akita DAO

akitaDAOEscrow.descr: the app ID for the akita DAO escrow

creatorRoyalty.descr: the amount the creator will get for the sale

expiration.descr: the timestamp the listing expires on, once this passes all that can be done is delist

factoryFloat.descr:
rev 3+: the creation MBR the factory advanced for a legacy-paid listing (0 otherwise). The factory
reads it before deletion and recovers it ahead of the funder refund; the Listing only stores it.

gateID.descr: the gate ID to use to check if the user is qualified to buy

isPrizeBox.descr: whether or not the prize is an asset or a prize box

lastPriceRound.descr: the round of the last price change (0 = never changed); purchases wait out a cooldown after it

marketplace.descr:
The address of the marketplace that listed the asset to send the fee to

IMPORTANT: this is a double sided marketplace fee contract
the marketplace referred to internally in the contract
is the listing side marketplace.
the buyer side marketplace provides their address at
the time of purchase

marketplaceRoyalties.descr: the amount the marketplaces will get for the sale

paymentAsset.descr: the asset to use for payment

prize.descr: the asset for sale: Asset | Application ( Prize Box )

prizeAmount.descr: the amount of the prize asset escrowed at listing time (0 for prize boxes)

reservedFor.descr: the address the sale is reserved for

rev.descr: program revision; absent on legacy listings so the factory can tell them apart

sellerReferrer.descr:
the seller's referrer, fixed by the factory at creation (rev 3+): the verified principal's referrer
on the hinted `list`, the registry referrer on the legacy shim. Settlement pays the referral cut
here with no registry read. Zero address = no referral. (Rev-absent deployed listings never paid a
seller referral: their registry lookup keyed on `Txn.sender`, which is always the factory.)

version.descr: the current version of the contract

args.name: payment
args.desc: - the payment for purchasing the asset

methods.name: delist
methods.desc: Deletes the app and returns the asset/mbr to the seller

methods.name: optin

args.name: asset
args.desc: The asset to be opted into

methods.desc: optin tells the contract to opt into an asa
